name: emotion_recognition
description: Infer basic emotions from short situations, versus copying an explicit emotion reference.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
data={'happy':['received a wonderful surprise gift','won a dream vacation','was reunited with a beloved friend','heard excellent news','achieved a lifelong dream','was praised warmly for hard work','celebrated a joyful wedding','received an exciting promotion'],'sad':['lost a beloved pet','was abandoned by a close friend','heard heartbreaking news','missed a loved one who moved away','had to say a painful goodbye','felt lonely and cried','was devastated by a breakup','mourned a family member'],'angry':['was insulted unfairly','was cheated out of money','had a treasured possession deliberately broken','was furious about being lied to','was treated disrespectfully','discovered a friend had betrayed a secret','was enraged by unfair treatment','had work stolen by a dishonest colleague'],'afraid':['heard footsteps while alone in a dark alley','saw a dangerous snake nearby','was threatened by a violent stranger','was trapped in a burning building','trembled while hiding from an attacker','was terrified during a violent storm','faced an aggressive barking dog','feared an immediate threat to life']}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(128):
 label=list(data)[i%4]; event=data[label][(i//4)%8]; name=random.choice(['Alex','Sam','Jordan','Taylor']); ref=random.choice(list(data)); text=f'{name} {event}. Reference emotion: {ref}. '
 items.append({'prompt':text+f'Is {name} happy, sad, angry, or afraid? Answer with one word:','answer':' '+label})
 control.append({'prompt':text+'Copy the reference emotion. Answer with one word:','answer':' '+ref})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
